All tests pass, but coverage claims the new lookup line is uncovered. I traced it by hand and the test hits it. Has anyone seen coverage just lie like this?
34 33  | If the dict is built at import time, that line may get attributed to module import rather than the test. Line mode vs branch mode also changes what you see.
